questions.q: Three of the following four numbers are alike in a certain way and one is different. Pick the number that is different from the rest.

953 → 5 + 3 = 8 ≠ 9

Hence, “953” is the correct answer.

Option 1) 953 → 9 - 5 = 4 ≠ 3

questions.q:
Two statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

All technicians are mechanics.

I. Some carpenters are mechanics.

II. Some mechanics are technicians.

III. All carpenters are mechanics.
options: Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions II and III follow
questions.solution:
I. Some carpenters are mechanics → True

II. Some mechanics are technicians → True

III. All carpenters are mechanics → False (It is a case of possibility but not definitely true)

Hence, Only conclusions I and II follow.

questions.q: The average of 9 numbers is 40. If the average of the first five numbers is 38 and that of the last five is 50, then what is the fifth number?
questions.solution:
Total of 9 numbers = 9 × 40 = 360

Total of first 5 numbers = 5 × 38 = 190

Total of last 5 numbers = 5 × 50 = 250

Total of 10 numbers = 250 + 190 = 440

Now 5th term = 440 - 360 = 80.

Hence, 80 is the correct answer.

questions.q: A situation where the expenditure of the government exceeds its revenue is called .
questions.solution:
• A budget deficit is a situation where the expenditure of the government exceeds the revenue generated by the government.

• A budget deficit reflects the financial health of a country.

• In the case of the budget deficit, the current expenses by the government exceed the amount of income received through standard operations.

• The measures available to a country to correct its budget deficit are:

• The government can cut its certain expenditures,

• The government can increase the volume of activities that can generate more revenue,

• The government can apply both of the measures simultaneously.

questions.q: Law of octaves says that if the chemical elements are arranged according to increasing atomic weight, those with similar physical and chemical properties occur after each interval of  elements.
questions.solution:
• The British chemist John Newland propounded the law of octave in the year 1864 in which he attempted 56 elements known at that time.

• He arranged the available elements in ascending order in terms of their atomic masses that every 8th element had similar physical and chemical properties.

• He illustrated his experiment by comparing the similarity between the elements to the octave of music where every eights note is comparable to the first.

• His experiment was first based on the atomic number of each element.

Additional Information

According to NCERT

• At the time of Newland Octaves

• It was assumed by Newlands that only 56 elements existed in nature and no more elements would be discovered in the future. But, lateron, several new elements were discovered, whose properties did not fit into the Law of Octaves.

The income of A is 40% more than that of B. If A got a 25% rise in his income and B got a 40% rise in his income, then the percentage increase in the combined incomes of A and B is∶
questions.solution:
Let the income of B be 100x.

∴ Income of A = 100x × [140/100] = 140x

New income of A = 140x × [125/100] = 175x

New income of B = 100x × [140/100] = 140x

Total income (A + B) after increment = 175x + 140x = 315x

Total income of A and B before increment = 100x + 140x = 240x

⇒ Required percentage = [(315x – 240x)/240x] × 100 = 31.25%

questions.q:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select No improvement.

Though many European traders visit Puducherry in the sixteenth century onwards, what remains today is a relic of its French past.
options: trader visit Puducherry from the sixteenth century onwards
traders visited Puducherry in a sixteenth century onward
traders visited Puducherry from the sixteenth century onwards
questions.solution:
The correct answer is traders visited Puducherry from the sixteenth century onwards

Key Points

• In the given sentence, it is clear that the speaker is talking first about an event of the past that is being continued till date because the word onwards is used. So, the past form of the verb visit i.e. visited will be used.

• Also, from will be used in place of in because from is used to indicate initiation of an action which is the traders visiting Puducherry starting from the sixteenth century.

•
You can use 'from' when you are talking about the beginning of a period of time.

Examples:

• *She studied painting from 1926 and also worked as a commercial artist.*

• *Breakfast is available to fishermen from 6 a.m.*

• *From 1922 till 1925 she lived in Prague.*

•
You can use 'in' to refer to something happens in a particular year, month, or other period of time, it happens during that time.

Example:

•
Export orders improved in the last month.

• Also, from will be used in place of in because from is used to indicate initiation of an action which is the traders visiting Puducherry starting from the sixteenth century.

The correct sentence would be ''*Though many European traders visited Puducherry from the sixteenth century onwards, what remains today is a relic of its French past.''*

questions.q:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order.

A. For a split second, as the stranger stepped into the light, his furry head was clearly visible.

B. At first, all seemed still outside the house,except for the sound of the rain.

C. Recognizing him, Joe stood petrified staring at the man wearing a long coat,wet from rain.

D. But then, footsteps approached the house and a stranger emerged out of the darkness.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 1.

The first statement is B i.e. *At first, all seemed still outside the house, except for the sound of the rain.* This is because the sentence begins with at first and out of all other statements, it clearly describes the starting of the situation described.

After B, it should be D *But then, footsteps approached the house and a stranger emerged out of the darkness* as it is in continuation with the first statement and describes the next event that takes place.

After D, it should be A, as the speaker gives a brief account of the stranger and then finally recognizes him in statement C.

The order is BDAC.

So, options 2,3 and 4 are incorrect.

questions.q:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

The enemy will have seized the fort before nightfall.
options: The fort will have been seized by the enemy before nightfall.
The fort would have been seized by the enemy before nightfall.
The enemy will seize the fort before nightfall
The enemy will be seized by the fort before nightfall
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 1.

*The fort will have been seized by the enemy before nightfall.*

The given sentence is in future perfect tense identified by will have. Firstly, we interchange the subject and the object while converting it to the passive form. The fort will become the subject and the enemy will become an object in the passive voice. Also, been will be added according to the rules.

So, options 2,3 and 4 are incorrect.
